parent_objective: design limited public replay preflight for M1346 candidate
blocked_by: M1347 admits limited replay preflight but no scoped replay protocol has been selected
supersedes: direct PPO or promotion from M1346 objective metrics

public_gates: M1348 must not use private holdout
M1348 must preserve actor input contract
M1348 must define the replay preflight tiers and stop conditions
forbidden_shortcuts: do not skip first-row proof preflight
do not treat objective metrics as replay proof

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: turns the M1347 audit route into a bounded replay-preflight protocol before any replay run
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process design only; no replay result, promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if design skips M267/M264 or M183/M170 first-row proof preflights
stop if design routes directly to PPO
stop if design permits promotion from limited replay alone
fallback_plan: if replay design is clean, route to one limited public replay preflight run
if replay tools do not match M1154/M1346 lineage, route to adapter implementation
if required corpora are missing, route to replay-corpus availability audit
if candidate scope is too broad, route to objective tradeoff repair design
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1347 admits replay preflight but requires a scoped protocol before running gates

admission_evidence: M1346 exact objective and eval fold improved without forbidden mutation
M1347 admits replay preflight but blocks promotion and PPO
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1348 only designs replay preflight for a fixed-objective candidate and cannot claim closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: design first proof preflights that compare correct-history and wrong-history retention before broader replay
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1346 candidate plus existing public replay/proof surfaces.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If limited replay fails, classify failure as proof_washout or behavior_regression before objective repair or PPO.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A limited public replay preflight protocol can be designed for the M1346 candidate that checks proof washout before any PPO or promotion decision.
success_criteria: design specifies candidate and base checkpoints
design specifies first preflight proof gates and stop conditions
design specifies whether existing tooling is sufficient or adapter work is needed
no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, actor update, checkpoint mutation, or actor-input expansion occurs
failure_criteria: design routes directly to PPO or promotion
training, PPO, private holdout, promotion, threshold relaxation, actor update, checkpoint mutation, replay run, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1348 passes as a design milestone only if it defines a bounded replay-preflight protocol and keeps PPO, promotion, private holdout, replay execution, and actor-input changes blocked.
